sources.title: Rank 1 Overall EUNE Top 5 KR Top 8 EUW I Season 16 Kayle Guide
Kayle 1v9's Season 16 Challenger Kayle Guide *Updated for 26.09*

passive.name: Divine Ascent
passive.text: Kayle's attacks are empowered by the heavens as she levels up and spends skill points. Her wings are lit aflame as she progressively gains Attack Speed, Move Speed, Attack Range, and waves of fire on her attacks.

spells.name: Radiant Blast
spells.text: Kayle conjures a portal, summoning a celestial sword that pierces through enemies, slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit.

spells.name: Celestial Blessing
spells.text: Blessed by the divine, Kayle heals and grants Move Speed to herself and the nearest ally.

spells.name: Starfire Spellblade
spells.text: Passive: Kayle's celestial sword, Virtue, deals bonus magic damage to enemies she attacks.Active: Kayle's next attack smites her target with celestial fire, dealing bonus damage proportionate to their missing health.

spells.name: Divine Judgment
spells.text: Kayle makes an ally invulnerable and calls upon former Aspects of Justice to purify the area around her target with a holy rain of swords.

damage.value: Kayle deals sustained magic damage through Starfire Spellblade’s passive bonus damage on her attacks.

archetype.value: Kayle is an attack-focused carry who grows stronger as she levels up and spends skill points.

axis.value: Kayle's lane rewards careful trades, knowing when to walk up and avoiding deaths.

winCondition.value: Kayle can snowball an early lead by playing patiently.

spikes.why: Kayle gains Attack Speed, Move Speed, Attack Range, and waves of fire as Divine Ascent progresses.

bait.why: Kayle cannot slow or reduce resistances with Radiant Blast again until its cooldown ends.
Kayle cannot heal or grant Move Speed with Celestial Blessing again during its 15-second cooldown.
Kayle cannot grant invulnerability with Divine Judgment again during its long cooldown.

mistakes.value: Kayle players make a mistake when they walk up at the wrong time and die.
